theorem n_succ_nonzero (m n : ℕ → ℕ)
  (h_recurrence : ∀ k : ℕ,
    (m (k + 1) : ℚ) / (n (k + 1) : ℚ) = (2 * (m k : ℚ) + 1) / (2 * (n k : ℚ) + 1)) :
  ∀ k, (n (k + 1) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
  intro k
  have h1 : (n (k + 1) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    have h2 : (n (k + 1) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h

    exact h2

theorem global_bound_from_h0 (t : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (h0 : t 0 ≤ N)
  (hnoninc : ∀ k, t (k + 1) ≤ t k) : ∀ k, t k ≤ N := by
